scope: launch-critical Astro UI typography authority and A=S=P binding

family.css_stack: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif
family.change_requires: N0 recorded owner/product decision plus updated Astro/thin-S/Penpot binding

delivery.repository_font_binary_classification: inactive inventory unless an explicit future authority decision names an exact asset and checksum

weights.consumer_rule: consume semantic weight tokens; do not redeclare a second font-family authority

actual_consumer_migration_bindings.current_bypass: direct Inter fallback-stack declaration on the document root
actual_consumer_migration_bindings.removal_boundary: remove only after the layout imports the canonical F0 registry and V0 confirms unchanged computed family/order

actual_consumer_migration_bindings.current_bypass: direct Inter stacks in the rail root and typography shorthands
actual_consumer_migration_bindings.removal_boundary: preserve accepted mobile rail density and line metrics; replace family ownership without redesign
migrate when this route enters the accepted launch-critical consumer set; no parallel font authority

thin_s_binding.delivery_note: record the CSS family stack and weight roles; do not bind arbitrary repository font binaries

penpot_binding.availability_boundary: R0.PENPOT may bind only an available matching family after N0 accepts the exact mapping; otherwise record a product decision blocker rather than silently substituting

source: no launch-critical consumer introduces another named family authority
repository font binaries are not counted as active web typography
browser: computed font-family order matches the canonical stack on representative headings, body, labels and metadata
computed font-weight matches the semantic role used by each specimen
no unexpected network font request or font-face substitution is required by the current source baseline
